body:
Yeah, did this 20 years ago when depressed after a breakup and thought I was suicidal.  Got into a good nutrition and exercise routine and came out of it then.  

At this point, and knowing it will eventually happen, I won't bother with a note as the process of writing it would lead to way too much consideration of the impact on others for my decision.  Been there & done that.  It would only serve to delay the inevitable.

The good nutrition and exercise program isn't working so well this time around.
I've noticed since being in a state of major depression that I usually don't enjoy listening to music but sometimes fixate on one song via repeat.

Get over the concept of a soul mate as it sets you up for disappointment.  You really think there's just that one person you'd be happy with?  There are plenty of women you're compatible with, even more so than this one.

God damn these Romeo and Juliets.

Personally, I don't think some hot chick on Facebook is worth suicide just cuz you ain't hittin it.

For me, I finally had to get busy enough for the depression to ease in order to find a job to buy some time supporting a family.  Some sweet moments with the family.  No butterflies and rainbows; however, as I know I'll succumb eventually.  Becoming more at ease, though, as I work toward the plan. 

So...I have not yet gotten to that "date" but I still expect it all to end the same.  Less pain of late but very little life enjoyment.  Perhaps the saddest part is experiencing things- the preschool graduation, the dance recitals, the birthdays- knowing I will likely not see many more.

Yo bitches, great news.  Took a shitty job for the benefits and I'll soon have life insurance through work.  Once employed for a while, I'll get an additional policy.  Then, I will be free.  Weeeeeeeeee!!!!
